actual: 2026-06-08 live validation shows two minqmt_sim daily runs marked SUCCEEDED while qmt_batch_status=PREFLIGHT_FAILED, broker_called=false, submitted_intents=0, failed_intents=54/16 and /api/v1/qmt/orders plus /trades are empty. Manual scheduler tick reuses existing plans and cannot retry because runs are terminal; deterministic qmt order_batch cache keeps PREFLIGHT_FAILED. Root cause candidates: lifecycle maps MiniQMT submit failure to success, retry eligibility ignores preflight-failed no-side-effect runs, and rebalance preflight rejects aggregate BUY before SELL proceeds/sequence are considered.
